video_goal: A step-by-step visual guide on assembling and powering on a ResMed AirSense 10 CPAP machine with a heated humidifier.
required_subjects_and_props: ResMed AirSense 10 CPAP machine, HumidAir water chamber, distilled water, ClimateLineAir heated tubing, CPAP mask, power supply.

outline_steps.visual_action: Two hands place the dark gray ResMed AirSense 10 main unit onto a wooden nightstand.
A hand inserts the circular power plug into the rear port of the machine, and a green LED illuminates on the power brick.
A thumb presses the side release latch and pulls the clear plastic HumidAir water chamber out of the machine.
A hand flips open the chamber lid and pours distilled water from a jug exactly up to the printed 'Max' fill line.
Two thumbs press down on the clear plastic lid of the water chamber until a visible snap occurs.
A hand slides the filled HumidAir water chamber back into the side slot of the machine until it sits flush.
Fingers pinch the orange connector end of the gray ClimateLineAir heated tubing, bringing it into focus.
A hand aligns the orange connector with the circular air port on the back of the machine and pushes it inward.
The hand twists the orange connector clockwise until it locks, aligning the electrical pins.
The opposite end of the gray tubing is pushed firmly onto the hard plastic swivel connector of a CPAP mask.
An index finger presses the large, circular 'Start/Stop' button located on the top right of the machine.
The angled LCD screen illuminates brightly, displaying a green 'SmartStart' icon and a numerical pressure dial.
